# The field guide rebuild: what the grill settled

Grilled over two days. An invented page for the Board's tests.

## Why

Writers and photographers must be able to open the guide's records and change them without reading code.

## Shape

Twelve areas, built in order: ground rules, the test harness, the shell, entries as records, search, the entry
page, the map page, menus and cards, sounds, saved trips, the photo handover and the release tool.

## Scope

The rebuild changes how the guide is built, not what a reader sees.
